product_one_liner.value: Fundraise Up is an online donation and fundraising platform for nonprofit organizations that helps increase donation conversion and revenue and grow recurring giving.
product_one_liner.notes: Company description and platform purpose are stated on the About page.

pricing_page.notes: A public pricing page describes performance-based fees, with no upfront or subscription fee.

named_customers.notes: Both organizations appear as Fundraise Up customer success stories in the case-study catalog.

employee_band.notes: The company reports 350+ team members worldwide, which falls in the 201-500 band.

hq_location.notes: The About page says the company is headquartered in Industry City, Brooklyn, New York.

founded_year.notes: The About page identifies 2017 as the founding year.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index shows Product, Fundraising, and News & Knowledge content, but I found no evidence there of at least two engineer-authored posts about building the product.

public_docs.notes: Fundraise Up has a public documentation site with multiple product and security documentation articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current careers listing includes open positions, but no role title matching AI, ML, machine learning, data science, applied/research scientist, NLP, LLM, or computer vision. Head of Data is not a qualifying title under the stated criteria.

model_provider.notes: Checked public product documentation, the AI-related blog content, and the available privacy/security/subprocessor information; these describe AI features or subprocessors but do not publicly name the AI model or model provider used by the product.

compliance_certs.notes: The compliance page names SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, GDPR/UK GDPR, and PCI DSS Level 1. No HIPAA certification was included.

last_funding.notes: The company and its investor announced a $70 million growth-capital investment in January 2025; funding coverage identifies it as the Series B round.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest located round was announced in January 2025, before the 18-month window beginning 2025-05-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The live careers listing includes an Account Executive, Education Vertical position.

launched_6mo.notes: The November 9, 2026 changelog announces new REST API functionality to create and manage campaigns and subaccounts, within the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: CEO Peter Byrnes announced Ahmed Naiem joining as Chief Revenue Officer; the announcement is within the 12 months before 2026-11-09.

crm_stack_signal.notes: These systems are named on Fundraise Up's integrations page or the corresponding Salesforce and HubSpot integration documentation.
